audience: support and documentation teams that keep a knowledge base in Helpjuice

useCases.title: Find unpublished or stale articles
useCases.text: List articles filtered by publish state or update date, and read their categories to find drafts that need review.

useCases.title: Search the knowledge base by keyword
useCases.text: Search the articles by keyword, optionally inside one category, then open an article to read its full text.

useCases.title: Check who edited the articles
useCases.text: Read the activity log to see who changed which article and when, then look up the editor's user record.

useCases.title: Draft a new article
useCases.text: Create an article in one or more categories. It stays a draft unless you set it to published.

useCases.title: Update an existing article
useCases.text: Change the fields you pass in an article. Setting it to published changes what readers see.
